scope_note: Four candidate geological hypotheses formulated after auditing all 28 merged GEMSDOE86 lanes on main, open sibling PR #179 (H86N-SHPB), registry/followup_hypotheses_20261025.json, registry/h86o_hypotheses_20261025.json, and all 27 GeoTIFFs across focus sites GEMSDOE24/25/27/28/30/31/32/33/36. Ranked qualitatively by expected spatially blocked HOLDOUT-DTI and off-catalogue discovery potential per implementation cost. No numeric live score projection is made (projections are never scores).
ranking_basis: Qualitative expected information gain on buffered whole-component spatially blocked HOLDOUT-DTI (gems57-pooled-hide-v2, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangle kernel) and blind off-catalogue Great Basin fault physics per implementation cost, weighted by radial far-field (>1 km) discovery power and mimic suppression.

hypotheses.physical_signature: Combines five untried translation-invariant operators: (1) Downslope one-sided Total Count (Band 6 tc) wash-blanket depletion asymmetry across mesoscale piedmont breaks (+/-450 m along -grad G_5(Band 12), IQR-normalized, GeoDAWN seam-vetoed and Lahontan 1330 m/1205 m bench-suppressed); (2) Cross-strike basement-depth second-derivative footwall hinge kink n_b^T H(Band 15) n_b strictly signed by independent horizontal gravity-drop concordance max(0, -n_b . (B18, B11)) and pulled back up-dip by adaptive Salem cot(dip); (3) One-sided hydrothermal smectite clay-cap lateral fault-seal termination max(0, n_b . grad log(1+B17_+)) gated by RTP magnetite-destruction deficit; (4) Seismicity-conditioned transtensional dilatancy conjunction gate (Bands 7,8 x Bands 10,16); and (5) Aitchison (1982) centered log-ratio (CLR) radiometric compositional Jacobian norm across (Band 6 TC, K, eTh, eU). Coupled via de-crowded (4.5 px stress-shadow negative buffer) 4-fold eroded-LOQO Elkan-Bayes PU + radial-and-cover-aware Noisy-OR fusion + Exact 6-Ring Bernoulli Survival Dinkelbach-CELF (37,654 dots, d_min=2.8 px, d_cat>3.0 px).
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: USGS/INGENIOUS Quaternary fault mapping relies heavily on preserved subaerial scarps. Piedmont faults beveled by sheetfloods still juxtapose U/Th/K-bearing footwall fanhead detritus against fine distal hanging-wall wash (Band 6 TC step); blind intrabasin half-graben master faults kink the basement surface (Band 15) with concordant vector gravity drops (B18, B11) under >200 m of fill; and blind Great Basin geothermal upflow zones (Bradys/Desert Peak/McGinness analogs) terminate conductive smectite clay caps (Band 17) laterally against sealing fault planes without surface scarps.
hypotheses.novelty: Band 6 (verified GeoDAWN Total Count) was unused in H86K-STDP, H86M-SLCQ, and sibling PR #179 (H86N-SHPB); H86O-2_TCW and H86O-3_DBK were proposed in registry/h86o_hypotheses_20261025.json as NOT_RUN_PROTOCOL_STOP and never implemented; prior lanes treated Band 17 only as symmetric ridges/necks rather than one-sided hanging-wall clay-cap lateral terminations; and prior coupled PU samplers excluded negatives inside 3.0-8.0 px (under-penalizing broadside stress-shadow halo clutter).
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted alluvial fan-toe progradation, playa evaporite rims, Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (1,330 m / 1,205 m) shoreline benches, GeoDAWN airborne survey stitch seams, Miocene Northern Nevada Rift mafic dikes, buried paleovalley thalwegs, and geothermal injection seismic swarms.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Highest qualitative priority: simultaneously sharpens near-catalogue tip/stepover selectivity via 4.5 px stress-shadow negative sampling and expands far-field (>1 km) blind piedmont/intrabasin/geothermal discovery.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~15 min CPU, <1.2 GB RSS, zero GPU, zero new external unpinned downloads).
hypotheses.external_data_source: Uses only SHA-256-pinned public-domain USGS GeoDAWN (doi:10.5066/P93LGLVQ), USGS 3DEP 1m/10m DEM, and DOE GDR #1391 (doi:10.15121/1881483) mirrors already verified in .cache/external/.

hypotheses.name: Thin-Plate Elastic Basement Flexural Shear Force (d^3_nnn Z_b) & Footwall-Uplift / Hanging-Wall-Moat Couple
hypotheses.physical_signature: Cross-strike directional third derivative -d^3_nnn Z_b (thin-plate elastic shear force V_n across a broken brittle upper crust, Te ~ 3-6 km) at sigma 4-8 px, gated by antisymmetric footwall residual uplift (Band 12 high-pass > 0 upslope) and hanging-wall gravity moat.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Cumulative Quaternary slip on blind piedmont step-out faults flexes both the buried basement interface and footwall pediment over 2-8 km wavelengths long after Holocene fan aggradation erases the narrow surface scarp.
hypotheses.novelty: H86I-HVFD used unsigned isotropic biharmonic magnitude ||nabla^4 Z_b||; no lane in GEMSDOE86 has computed the signed directional third-derivative flexural shear couple -d^3_nnn Z_b paired with footwall topographic residual polarity.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Differential compaction over buried caldera ring margins, granitic pluton roofs, and glacial/fluvial valley walls.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Medium-high qualitative priority for range-front step-out faults; coarser spatial localization (~400-800 m) than TCWB's pulled-back second-derivative hinge.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (~3 min CPU, native bands only).

hypotheses.name: Full Aitchison Compositional Radiometric Tensor Decomposition (Provenance Juxtaposition vs Constant-Th Epithermal Fault Metasomatism)

layers.external: geodawn_rad_u8.tif (K, eTh, eU), geodawn_extensions_u8.tif (Th/K, U/K, U/Th), acquisition_block_id_100m.tif

hypotheses.physical_signature: Eigen-decomposition of the 2x2 spatial structure tensor of Aitchison centered log-ratios clr(K, eTh, eU), projecting fault-normal jumps onto two orthogonal geochemical endmembers: (a) parallel Delta clr(eTh) + Delta clr(K) lithologic juxtaposition vs (b) orthogonal Delta(clr(K) - clr(eTh)) + Delta(clr(eU) - clr(eTh)) at |Delta clr(eTh)| ~ 0 (potassic adularia-illite + redox U fault-conduit alteration).
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: In eroded volcanic/epithermal terrains of the Walker Lane and Humboldt structural zone, fossil and active hydrothermal fault conduits leave 200-500 m K/U metasomatic halos and magnetite destruction along unmapped bedrock faults lacking Quaternary scarps.
hypotheses.novelty: Prior lanes (RKSC, STDP, SLCQ) used scalar K/Th and U/Th gradient magnitudes; scalar CLR norm is introduced inside H86P-TCWB, whereas full 2-endmember tensor eigen-separation of provenance vs constant-Th metasomatism remains a standalone follow-up.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted rhyolite-ash-flow tuff cooling-unit boundaries, potash-richalkali playa crusts, and agricultural fertilizer runoff.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Moderate qualitative priority: strong in exposed/thinly covered volcanic blocks, weaker in deep carbonate/alluvial basins.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-medium (~4 min CPU, pinned GeoDAWN + native bands).

hypotheses.name: EarthScope USArray 3-D Magnetotelluric Mid-Crustal Sub-Vertical Conductive Fault-Root Curtain

layers.external_unmirrored: IRIS/EarthScope USArray 3-D Western US Electrical Conductivity Model depth slices (3-15 km)

hypotheses.physical_signature: Horizontal phase-tensor skew and lateral log-conductivity gradient of 3-15 km EarthScope MT resistivity inversions aligned with shallow Band 17 cond_surf terminations and Band 10 hypocentral seismicity.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Major Great Basin geothermal range-front and accommodation-zone faults (e.g., Dixie Valley, Carson Sink, Buena Vista) root into sub-vertical mid-crustal magmatic/metamorphic fluid conductors detectable beneath thick basin fill.
hypotheses.novelty: Band 17 captures only shallow near-surface conductance; no repo lane incorporates 3-D mid-crustal MT resistivity depth slices.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Graphitic Paleozoic black-shale thrusts (Roberts Mountains allochthon) and broad conductive magmatic underplating.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Moderate-high regional prior, limited at 100 m pixel scale by ~35-70 km USArray MT station spacing.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium, but currently DEFERRED in this sandbox because outbound network egress is restricted to github.com/pypi.org/npmjs.org and no SHA-pinned 3-D USArray MT volume is mirrored in the org repositories.
hypotheses.external_data_source: Free official public source: NSF EarthScope / IRIS SPUD EMTF & USGS ScienceBase 3-D MT Resistivity Models (https://ds.iris.edu/spud/emtf, https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/; Kelbert, Egbert & Schultz 2014).
